choices.why: No candidate comes in green velvet, so this dark charcoal three-seat sofa is the closest to the deep tone you asked for, and its rolled arms and turned legs suit the classic room and are wide enough to anchor the fireplace.
A pair of matching rolled-arm armchairs from the same line as the sofa makes a cohesive, traditional group facing each other across the hearth.
At 292x231 cm, this classic medallion rug is large enough to sit under the whole seating group, and its charcoal and ivory palette ties the upholstery to the black mantel.
This dark espresso coffee table has a traditional X-base, and its 120 cm length fits well between the sofa and the fireplace.
This 102 cm champagne-gold fretwork mirror is in good proportion to the mantel and adds elegant light to the tall chimney breast.
Its turned column and linen drum shade give it a classic look that matches the moldings and the turned legs of the sofa and armchairs.

answer.why: Since there is no green velvet option, a dark charcoal sofa and matching rolled-arm armchairs on a grey-and-ivory medallion rug echo the black fireplace and stand out against the pale blue-green walls. The dark wood table, gilded mirror and linen-shaded lamp add classic warmth and elegance to this period room.
